text:
Predicates:
IstanbulPlate(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate from Istanbul.
BeginWith34(x) ::: x begins with the number 34.
BeginWith35(x) ::: x begins with the number 35.
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x is from Istanbul.
Premises:
∀x (IstanbulPlate(x) → BeginWith34(x)) ::: All vehicle registration plates in Istanbul begin with the number 34.
∀x (¬BeginWith34(x) → ¬FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates that do not begin with the number 34 are not from Istanbul.
IstanbulPlate(joe) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginWith35(tom) ::: Tom's license plate begins with the number 35.
BeginWith35(tom) → ¬BeginWith34(tom) ::: If a license plate begins with the number 35, then it does not begin with the number 34.
Conclusion:
FromIstanbul(tom) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
